items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then you got a picture of the brass band with the D and Howard and Clayton and Jim Robinson and I think Eddie Summers you said? [INTERVIEWEE] No, not Eddie Summers, Harrison Bradley. Harrison Bradley, yeah.

ctx.x: You see Howard up there with the dirt on?
Yeah, I can see Howard and you and George and Lawrence and Jim, I guess the dragon.
And drag, yeah, drag on the back of the beast.
